subject: Quarterly readout prep: compact account one-pagers + forecast stitch
messages:
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly readout prep: compact account one-pagers + forecast stitch

Team —

We have 6 accounts that will drive >70% of the Q3 ARR movement for the Sales org. For the leadership readout next Wednesday I want a very compact, page-per-account brief for each of the top six, plus a single consolidated forecast sheet that stitches committed vs best-case and highlights gaps to target.

Ask: can each of you own two accounts and produce a one-pager using the attached template by EOD Monday (attached: compact-onepager-template.xlsx)? Key fields: Current ARR, ARR at risk (by reason), next milestone, ask (exec touch / procurement), and forecast confidence (H/M/L).

Marissa — can you lead consolidation of those one-pagers into forecast-stitch-v1.csv and surface a short variance narrative? Rishi — please run a brief slippage analysis against the last 90 days of movement and flag any accounts with >20% downward revision. Laura — I may need a 5-slide appendix for exec Q where we call out top mitigation plays.

I'll schedule short 20-minute run-throughs Tuesday afternoon so we can raise blockers early. If there's any reason we can't meet the Monday deadline, call it out now.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: compact-onepager-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly readout prep: compact account one-pagers + forecast stitch

Jonas —

Thanks — confirmed. I've split the accounts: I will take Acme and Hightower; Rishi will take Nova and Skyline; Jonas (you) and Laura will cover the rest (please confirm).

Attached: blank template and a quick example one-pager I prepared for a different account so people have formatting guidance. Quick notes on the consolidation file I plan to produce:
- Columns: Account, Owner, Current ARR, Committed ARR, Best-case ARR, Risk Code, Next Milestone (date), Procurement ETA, Exec Ask, Confidence (H/M/L)
- I will produce forecast-stitch-v1.csv by EOD Monday and a short narrative (250–350 words) summarizing net delta vs plan and the top three risk drivers.

Open questions:
1) For ARR at risk, use sales-opportunity states (Committed/Contracting/Verbal/Forecast-only) — confirm?
2) Should we include customer success health score as a column or keep it in the appendix? My vote: appendix to keep one-pager lean.

If that sounds good I'll start pulling numbers and reach out to Claire at Acme for a quick revenue confirmation (will loop them in).

—Marissa
Sr. Account Strategist, Redwood Inference

Attachments: compact-onepager-template.xlsx, example-onepager-acme.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly readout prep: compact account one-pagers + forecast stitch

Quick note: confirmed I'll take Nova and Skyline. Will run the 90-day slippage script tonight and surface any account with >20% negative movement. Also will add a short "driver" tag (procurement delay / technical milestone / budget cycle) that can be used for sorting in the consolidated file.

If anyone wants me to call customers for confirmations, I can do so Monday morning — otherwise I'll request the figures over email (faster).

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Field Sales Operations

From: Claire Barnes <claire@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 17:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acme renewal numbers

Hi Marissa —

Per our call earlier this week, Acme confirms the following: Current ARR under contract: $1,250,000. Procurement expects to sign amendment for expanded seats by 2027-07-10; PO routing may add 7–10 business days. No technical blockers; internal approval is currently with Finance (SLA exception request).

I've attached a short PDF confirmation from Finance. If you need an exec intro to close the PO faster, I can arrange a 30-minute call with our Head of Procurement next Tuesday morning.

Best,
Claire Barnes
Director, Cloud Architecture
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme-revenue-confirmation.pdf (pdf)

From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated stitch (v1) and next steps — readout prep schedule

Great updates — thanks everyone. I've pulled Marissa's sample one-pager and Claire's confirmation into the consolidated sheet (forecast-stitch-v1.csv attached). High-level summary:

- Committed ARR total across the six accounts: $3.9M
- Best-case ARR (if all verbal convert): $4.6M
- Net delta vs Q target: -$300k (gap) with top risk drivers being procurement delays (2 accounts) and internal budget hold (1 account)

Next actions:
1) Marissa — finalize the one-pagers for Acme and Hightower by COB Monday and drop into the Drive folder.
2) Rishi — share the slippage table and add the driver tags to the CSV.
3) Laura — draft the 5-slide appendix that calls out mitigation plays (exec intro, short-term discount, targeted pilot) — I want that by Tuesday 9am PT.
4) I'll run a 20-minute sync Tuesday 3:00–3:20pm PT (calendar invite incoming) to triage any blockers.

I'll also mark the Acme account as candidate for an exec intro — Marissa, please coordinate timing with Claire and let me know if Tuesday AM with their procurement lead works; I'll join if they want an exec-level push.

Thanks — this is in good shape. Keep updates to the consolidated sheet and don't change column headers so the deck generation script picks them up.

Jonas
VP Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: forecast-stitch-v1.csv (csv)
